title: Oven-Baked Norwegian Chicken Stew
description: A malty, tender quick-fix Norwegian dish featuring massaman paste and fermented kimchi, baked in a bamboo tray for a flavorful one-pan meal.
instructions: Place the bamboo tray on a baking sheet and lightly oil it with 1 tsp olive oil.
In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, massaman paste, salt, pepper, and 2 tsp olive oil; toss until coated.
Scatter the coated chicken onto the tray, then add carrots, potatoes, and fermented kimchi around them.
Pour coconut milk and chicken broth over the ingredients, ensuring everything is moistened but not drowned.
Cover the tray loosely with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil, stir the stew gently, and bake uncovered for another 15 minutes until the chicken is tender and the vegetables are soft.
Remove from oven and squeeze fresh lime juice over the stew; sprinkle chopped cilantro on top.
Let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot straight from the bamboo tray.
